_note: R-094. FixedArray had a dedicated pass in all seven tiers, nine-format examples, and ZERO conformance fixtures — and four independent FixedArray defects coexisted behind that gap. Grid2x2 covers array literals and LITERAL-index access; this fixture covers the runtime-index READ, which is what expand-fixed-arrays lowers into a chain of index comparisons. Stateless on purpose: the differential execution oracle has no stateful lane, so a stateful fixture could not carry a witness at all.
